2607.11689.title: From World Action Models to Embodied Brains: A Roadmap for Open-World Physical Intelligence
2607.11689.paper_summary: Artificial general intelligence ultimately requires agents that can reason and act in the physical world. Action models, vision-language-action policies, and world models have advanced this goal, while World Action Models (WAMs) are particularly promising because they connect candidate interventions with predicted consequences. However, progress remains fragmented: models use incompatible action spaces and prediction targets, datasets and tasks follow different conventions, and runtime systems expose limited interfaces for reuse and evaluation. We review the evolution toward WAMs and organize these limitations into three coupled gaps: model roles and representations, objectives and standardization, and system composition. Building on this analysis, we propose a co-evolution roadmap for physical intelligence centered on the \emph{embodied brain}, a long-term model target for integrating multimodal context, comparing candidate interventions, and issuing state-transition or capability requests rather than direct actuator commands. WAMs provide promising prototypes for its predictive functions, while a physical harness grounds model outputs through tools, controllers, verification, and trace logging. Shared contracts align heterogeneous models, data, tasks, and embodiments, and closed-loop post-training converts verified interaction into reusable experience. Together, these components define a modular physical-intelligence stack for adaptive and self-improving embodied agents.
2607.11689.paper_summary_zh: 人工通用智慧最終需要能夠在物理世界中推理和行動的代理。<lb/>行動模型、視覺-語言-行動政策和世界模型推進了這一目標，而世界行動模型（WAMs）特別有前景，因為它們將候選干預與預測結果相連接。<lb/>然而，進展仍然是片段化的：模型使用不兼容的行動空間和預測目標，數據集和任務遵循不同的約定，運行時系統提供有限的接口以便重用和評估。<lb/>我們回顧了WAMs的演變，並將這些限制組織成三個相互關聯的缺口：模型角色和表示、目標與標準化，以及系統組成。<lb/>基於這一分析，我們提出了一個以\emph{具身大腦}為中心的物理智慧共演化路線圖，這是一個長期的模型目標，用於整合多模態上下文、比較候選干預，並發出狀態轉換或能力請求，而不是直接的執行器命令。<lb/>WAMs提供了其預測功能的有希望的原型，而物理鞍具通過工具、控制器、驗證和追蹤日誌將模型輸出落實。<lb/>共享合約對齊異質模型、數據、任務和具身體，並且閉環後訓練將驗證的交互轉換為可重用的經驗。<lb/>這些組件共同定義了一個模組化的物理智慧堆疊，適用於自適應和自我改進的具身代理。
